verdict.rationale: Attio's core data model is built around linked People/Company records (with optional Deal object) connected via a graph model, custom attributes, and lists, and record pages show full interaction history ("Get instant visibility into the full history of every interaction") alongside real-time contact syncing. This directly matches ops needs for linked contact/company records with activity timelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and more detail on what exactly populates the timeline (calls, emails, notes) versus marketing copy.
